l7.title: ALSVID L7 · Step-through carbon folding e-bike
l7.description: Discover ALSVID L7: a 20-inch step-through carbon folding e-bike reference with torque-sensing assistance and an integrated carrying opening.
l7.headline: An easier way into the everyday.
l7.intro: A lower step-through frame, carbon construction and a compact fold. L7 combines electric assistance with an integrated carrying opening for everyday urban journeys.

l7.design.title: Step through. Ride on. Carry along.
l7.carbon.title: A lower point of entry.
l7.carbon.body: The reference bike pairs a step-through carbon frame with a carbon fork. Its lower frame opening makes mounting and dismounting more accessible.
l7.assist.title: Support that responds to your effort.
l7.assist.body: A torque sensor regulates the rear-hub assistance according to your pedalling. The reference configuration uses a {power} W motor with up to {torque} Nm.
l7.fold.kicker: Make space for what comes next
l7.fold.title: A full ride. A compact pause.
l7.fold.body: Frame and handlebar fold for storage between rides. The reference dimensions are listed below; final ALSVID dimensions and measured weight depend on the confirmed build.

l7.available.title: A first look. More details to follow.
l7.available.body: This model is available by reservation only; no stock is available. The reservation lead time is four months. Final ALSVID configuration and pricing will be announced officially.
l7.launch.body: A lower step-through frame, pedal-responsive support and an integrated carrying opening. Meet the other side of compact urban riding.
l7.carry.title: A handle, built into the frame.
l7.carry.body: The opening within the frame forms a carrying grip. It is shown here on the reference bike, alongside the central folding mechanism.
